title: 5496 : fixed UI crash from excessive tick generation with invalid dates/intervals
description:
## Summary

This PR fixes a critical bug where Gantt charts with invalid dates or small tick intervals cause the UI to hang and become completely unresponsive. The issue was caused by a Temporal Dead Zone (TDZ) error and lack of validation for excessive tick generation, leading to infinite loops that freeze the browser.

## Resolves
Resolves #5496
